# omo-preset-switch

Process-scoped [oh-my-opencode-slim](https://www.npmjs.com/package/oh-my-opencode-slim) preset switcher for [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai).

- **TUI picker** `/omopreset` — interactive dialog, **zero LLM turns**
- **Server plugin** — applies the chosen preset for the current OpenCode process only (does not rewrite your slim config file)
- **In-session model rewrite** — next message in the current session uses the new preset models via `chat.message`
- **Full reload** — also reloads skills / MCPs / prompt overrides (~9s once)

## Requirements

- OpenCode ≥ 1.18.4
- `oh-my-opencode-slim` installed and configured with a `presets` map
- `@opencode-ai/plugin` peer (provided by OpenCode)

## Install

```bash
# anywhere OpenCode can resolve npm packages
npm install -g @endlex/omo-preset-switch
# or let OpenCode pull it via the plugin entry below
```

## Configure

### 1. Server plugin — `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`

Register **before** `oh-my-opencode-slim` so the env override is set before slim init:

```jsonc
{
  "plugin": [
    "@endlex/omo-preset-switch",
    "oh-my-opencode-slim"
    // ...other plugins
  ]
}
```

### 2. TUI plugin — `~/.config/opencode/tui.json`

```jsonc
{
  "plugin": [
    "@endlex/omo-preset-switch"
    // or "@endlex/omo-preset-switch/tui" if your OpenCode version prefers the explicit path
  ]
}
```

OpenCode loads the package’s `./tui` export for TUI plugins when the package name is listed.

### 3. Restart OpenCode

Config and plugins load at startup.

## Usage

1. Type `/omopreset` in the TUI
2. Pick a preset from your slim config (`presets.*`)
3. Wait for the completion dialog (~9s full reload)
4. Send the next message — it uses the new preset models in this process

`reset` clears the process-level override and falls back to the config-file default `preset`.

## How it works

| Layer | Role |
|---|---|
| TUI (`./tui`) | DialogSelect picker, writes a one-shot choice file, triggers instance dispose + reprovision, shows DialogAlert on completion |
| Server (`.`) | Consumes choice (init / fs.watch), sets `OH_MY_OPENCODE_SLIM_PRESET`, rewrites outbound message models via `chat.message`, strips the env var from shell/tool children |

Transport is process-scoped via:

```text
~/.local/state/opencode/omo-preset/<pid>-<dirhash>.{choice,status}.json
```

Nothing is written to `oh-my-opencode-slim.json`.

## Notes

- The stock TUI footer may still show the previous model until the session is reopened; actual LLM calls use the new model after a successful switch.
- Full reload cost is dominated by OpenCode re-bootstrap (skills, watchers, etc.), not this plugin.
- Do not mix with slim’s built-in `/preset` if you want process-only scope (`/preset` persists to config).
